sights.n: Tōrin-ji & Gongen-dō, Ishigaki (桃林寺・権現堂)
sights.w: Gongen-dō, beside Tōrin-ji temple in central Ishigaki, was first built in 1614, destroyed by the great Meiwa tsunami of 1771 and rebuilt; it was designated a national Important Cultural Property in 1981. The Agency for Cultural Affairs' database notes decorative details unusual in mainland shrine architecture and calls it Japan's southernmost surviving early-modern religious building of this scale.
sights.k: Japan's southernmost Important Cultural Property shrine hall, rebuilt after the 1771 tsunami
